entries.8c8fd541eedd0b85: The group consists of FAST RETAILING CO., LTD. as a holding company, 68 consolidated subsidiaries and 4 equity-method affiliates. Its main business is apparel sales: it plans apparel of brands such as “UNIQLO” and “GU,” and sells products made at outsourced sewing factories to consumers through its own stores and internet sales. Almost all of its revenue comes from apparel sales.
entries.8d0d05c50cf5e22a: The breakdown of revenue of ¥3,400,539 million for the fiscal year ended August 2025 is: Overseas UNIQLO Business ¥1,910,289 million, Domestic UNIQLO Business ¥1,026,096 million, GU Business ¥330,701 million, Global Brands Business ¥131,542 million, and other ¥1,910 million.
entries.91c2ab039d878bfd: Casual apparel under the GU brand
entries.94b01afe3cc7c30f: The UNIQLO business operated in Japan. It sells casual apparel under the UNIQLO brand within Japan. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥1,026,096 million.
entries.9a0da603e3f8f44b: Operating profit by segment for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥309,319 million for the Overseas UNIQLO Business, ¥184,451 million for the Domestic UNIQLO Business, ¥30,506 million for the GU Business, a loss of ¥950 million for the Global Brands Business, and ¥25 million for other. Consolidated operating profit, which adds revenue not attributable to each reportable segment and the adjustment amount of ¥40,684 million (corporate expenses), was ¥564,265 million. In addition, the group does not allocate assets or liabilities to reportable segments.
entries.9a1da868130833c4: A business that operates “COMPTOIR DES COTONNIERS” mainly in France.
entries.a7f895f52e8f98f0: Revenue from real estate leasing and other businesses
entries.b7894713e093b1b7: The group consists of FAST RETAILING CO., LTD. (the company), 68 consolidated subsidiaries and 4 equity-method affiliates. In November 2005, the company transitioned to a holding company structure to strengthen the UNIQLO business and expand new businesses. The reportable segments are 4: Domestic UNIQLO Business, Overseas UNIQLO Business, GU Business and Global Brands Business.
entries.bfd9a7b397a3b803: A business handling apparel under the “Theory” brand. In 2004, the company invested in Link Holdings Co., Ltd. (now Link Theory Japan Co., Ltd.), which operates “Theory,” and in 2009 made it a subsidiary through a tender offer.
entries.c255d31f639ec705: Products are bought by consumers who visit stores and by users of internet sales, which began in October 2000. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥1,366,172 million in Japan, ¥513,040 million in China and ¥1,521,325 million in other overseas regions, so regions outside Japan account for the majority.
